name: Jimmy Kimmel Live!
description: Jimmy Kimmel Live! is an American late-night talk show, created and hosted by Jimmy Kimmel and broadcast on ABC.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 1
videos.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics  In this pre-recorded primetime show, presented in conjunction with Game 1 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel welcomes comedian Russell Brand and matches NBA Most Valuable Player LeBron James against a local busboy in the arcade game Pop-a-Shot.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 2
videos.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics In this primetime show broadcast with Game 2 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Ashton Kutcher. In the second round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring a local busboy, the opponent is Basketball Hall of Famer Charles Barkley.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 3
videos.overview: Boston Celtics vs. LA Lakers In this primetime show broadcast with Game 3 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Drew Barrymore, Aunt Chippy plays blackjack to try and win $80,000 for the audience, and Guillermo visits the teams on media day and discusses "Sex and the City 2" with various players.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 4
videos.overview: Boston Celtics vs. LA Lakers In this primetime show broadcast with Game 4 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with the cast of "Grown Ups". In the third round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring a local busboy, the opponent is Lakers star Kobe Bryant.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 5
videos.overview: Boston Celtics vs. LA Lakers In this primetime show broadcast with Game 5 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Jessica Alba and attempts to shatter a backboard. In the fourth round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring a local busboy, the opponent is Lakers forward Lamar Odom.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 6
videos.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics In this primetime show broadcast with Game 6 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with David Arquette, and Dr. Phil McGraw offers his perspective on LeBron James' possible departure from Cleveland. In the final round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring local busboy Ricardo Reyes, the opponent is Nuggets All-Star Carmelo Anthony, with a surprise gift awaiting Ricardo if he again prevails.

videos.title: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 7
videos.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics In this primetime show broadcast with Game 7 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Danny DeVito, and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar narrates the "history" of the storied rivalry.

videos.overview: On a historic night where Jimmy Kimmel has previously debuted such pieces as the I'm F@#%-ing Ben Affleck music video and Mel Gibson's The Colonel, he introduced a new star-studded video including Jimmy and 15 of the most handsome men in Hollywood who come together for the handsomest gathering ever. Jimmy also welcomed two-time Academy Award® nominee Robert Downey Jr. who presented the world premiere of the new Iron Man 2 trailer, and a musical performance by Grammy Award® winner Keith Urban. Plus special appearances by Ben Affleck, Jennifer Garner, Matthew McConaughey, Patrick Dempsey, Sting, and many more.

Jimmy spoke with actress Kate Walsh (Legion and Private Practice) about turtles and speaking Spanish, and actor Aziz Ansari (Aziz Ansari: Intimate Moments for a Sensual Evening and Parks and Rec) about his breakthrough year on television and his fascination with R. Kelly. Also, musical guests Larry Gatlin and the Gatlin Brothers performed "Johnny Cash is Dead."

But first, Jimmy says goodbye to Michael Jackson's giraffes, J.J. and Rambo, who died, and we get a special peek into Guillermo's scandal on The Bachelor.

videos.title: After the Academy Awards
videos.overview:
On a historic night where Jimmy Kimmel has previously debuted such pieces as the I'm F@#%-ing Ben Affleck music video and Mel Gibson's The Colonel, he introduced a new star-studded video including Jimmy and 15 of the most handsome men in Hollywood who come together 

for the handsomest gathering ever.

Jimmy also welcomed two-time Academy Award® nominee Robert Downey Jr. who presented the world premiere of the new Iron Man 2 trailer, and a musical performance by Grammy Award® winner Keith Urban. Plus special appearances by Ben Affleck, Jennifer Garner, Matthew McConaughey, Patrick Dempsey, Sting, and many more.

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel’s Quarantine Minilogue - Home with Kids, Trump, Tom Brady & St. Patrick’s Day
videos.overview: Since we aren’t doing shows right now during this Coronavirus quarantine, Jimmy has nothing to do. He’s bored and he figured some of you may be as well so he decided that he’s going to shoot mini monologues at his house. In today’s #minilogue Jimmy talks about being home with his kids, how Donald Trump is handling all of this, Tom Brady leaving the New England Patriots, celebrating Saint Patrick’s Day at home, and we take the opportunity to rewatch the greatest local news story of all time - a leprechaun sighting in Mobile, Alabama. Jimmy will also be making a donation to a worthwhile cause every day during this quarantine. Today, it is No Kid Hungry. They make sure kids eat. Please consider helping them too

videos.title: Jimmy Kimmel's Quarantine Minilogue - Staying Normal, Guillermo's Snacks & Trump’s “Chinese Virus”
videos.overview: We aren’t doing shows right now during this Coronavirus quarantine, so Jimmy is shooting daily mini monologues at his house. In today’s #minilogue Jimmy talks about the United States and Canada temporarily closing the border, Trump calling the Coronavirus the “Chinese Virus,” The Governor of Nevada closing all hotels and casinos, how to stay “normal” during this uncertain time, and Jimmy has a message for older people who aren’t taking this seriously, and he videochats with Guillermo at his house to see how he’s holding up. Jimmy will be making a donation to a worthwhile cause every day during this quarantine. Today, it’s the American Red Cross. Please consider helping them too

videos.title: Bono, Nathan Fielder
videos.overview: The guests for Tuesday, May 27 included Bono ("Bono: Stories of Surrender”) and Nathan Fielder (“The Rehearsal”). Bono opens up about his deeply personal film Stories of Surrender, his life-changing surgery, his complex bond with his father, U2’s next chapter, and getting trolled by Trump. Nathan Fielder shares stories from The Rehearsal season two—including becoming a licensed 737 pilot and flying it over the Mojave—and jokes about being bumped for Bono.
